description: Maya is coordinating the move of her late grandfather's upright piano before his house is sold and must decide where and when it will go, with input from her cousin Ben and brother Lucas.

shared_context.S1: Their late grandfather's upright piano is still in his house, which is being sold at the end of August.
shared_context.S2: The piano needs to be moved before the house sale is completed.
shared_context.S3: Maya is coordinating the move and will make the final plan.
shared_context.S4: The family has a routine of checking with everyone for relevant practical information before committing to arrangements.
shared_context.S5: The piano is too heavy and delicate for the family to move safely in an ordinary car.

PF1.text: Ben's apartment manager confirmed that the building's upper floors and narrow stairwell cannot safely accommodate an upright piano, so Ben cannot receive it at Maya's initially suggested apartment destination; he has not brought this to Maya yet.

PF2.text: Lucas spoke with the coordinator of the Riverside Arts Room, who confirmed that the climate-controlled room can accept the piano only on 2025-08-17, with unloading scheduled from 10:00 to 12:00; this has not reached the family yet.

acceptance_conditions: Ben must not receive the piano.
The destination must be the Riverside Arts Room.
The move must be scheduled for August 17, 2025.
A commitment to confirm, schedule, book, or otherwise arrange acceptance and unloading with the Riverside Arts Room within the 10:00 to 12:00 window must exist.
Maya must record that she spoke aloud and cited Lucas's Riverside Arts Room information.

content_checks.C2: decisions['destination'] in ['Riverside Arts Room', 'Riverside Arts Room (climate-controlled storage)', 'Riverside Arts Room (climate-controlled room)']
content_checks.C5: any('Riverside Arts Room' in c['detail'] and ('unload' in c['detail'] or 'accept' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: decisions['destination'] in ['Riverside Arts Room', 'Riverside Arts Room (climate-controlled storage)', 'Riverside Arts Room (climate-controlled room)'] and decisions['move_start_time'] in ['10:00', '10:00 AM']

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed and decisions['maya_spoke_and_cited_pf2'] == True

decisive_facts.why: Ben's manager's restriction changes the recipient assignment from Ben receiving the piano to Ben not receiving it.

Lucas's confirmation changes the destination to Riverside Arts Room, fixes the move date at August 17, 2025 and unloading start at 10:00, requires an acceptance or unloading commitment, and supplies the information Maya must speak aloud and cite.
